paragraphs.text:
What a splendid ship! You have all the comforts of a big city 
within a few hundred feet of your cabin: beauty salon, fine men’s 
clothing, jewelry, sporting goods, books, etc. You decide to look 
at some new gloves. Make a successful Spot Hidden roll and go 
to 61. Otherwise, you continue your day. Go to 126. 
(126)
